z01-reservation.observed_description: Ana in her green overshirt with her dark-blue suitcase stands at a hotel front desk talking to a smiling young receptionist in a white shirt and dark vest; a dark passport lies on the counter.
z01-reservation.note: Usable: checking in at a hotel reads at 180 px.

z02-key.observed_description: At the hotel desk the receptionist holds out a brass key on a wooden tag and Ana reaches for it.
z02-key.note: Usable: Here's your key reads at 180 px; the key is between their hands.

z03-elevator.observed_description: Ana with her suitcase and a brass key steps out of an open steel elevator into a hotel hallway.
z03-elevator.note: Usable: the hotel elevator reads at 180 px; no readable buttons.

z04-room.observed_description: Ana with her suitcase and the brass key smiles in a bright hotel room with a big white bed by a window.
z04-room.note: Usable: her hotel room reads at 180 px.
